create_TesseractOcrCliModel: create a TesseractOcrCliModel instance to perform OCR on PDF pages using the Tesseract CLI
run_tesseract_ocr: run tesseract CLI on an image file to extract text with bounding boxes in TSV format
perform_osd_language_detection: perform OSD language detection on an image using Tesseract PSM 0 mode
parse_document_orientation: parse document orientation in degrees from Tesseract OSD output
set_tesseract_languages: set available Tesseract languages and detect script prefix from installed language models
